answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that grows with the trust it earns, like a vine that only thickens where it is tended: a new identity starts as a thin willow shoot of reputation and must be vouched for by several established, unrelated peers before it can earn. A Sybil attacker splitting stake across many fresh identities ends up with weak shoots, each too thin to pass the attestation threshold, while one honest agent stake stays crystal-clear and concentrated, so creating identities costs more than it returns.
